checkpoints.description: A 3D node-and-edge knowledge graph rendered in Qualia, dark theme, viewed in a browser viewport. SHADED: solid nodes and solid edges, no bloom, no glow, no film grain, no vignette. The clearest, flattest, most readable diagram of all the modes.
